name: Findter Mockup
start: pgrep -f 'http.server 8080' >/dev/null 2>&1 || (cd /workspace && nohup python3 -m http.server 8080 >/tmp/static-server.log 2>&1 &); sleep 1; curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://localhost:8080/ && echo 'static-server ready on http://localhost:8080/'

terminals.name: static-server-logs
terminals.command: cd /workspace && (pgrep -f 'http.server 8080' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'static server already running (started by start command); tailing logs' && tail -n +1 -F /tmp/static-server.log) || python3 -m http.server 8080
terminals.description: Static Findter mockup server on http://localhost:8080/ (root redirects to the Product Card Variant mockup). Tails the server log if the start command already launched it, otherwise runs the server in the foreground.
